Mark your calendar — Sip and Paint is landing on the Main Floor and Aubrey's bringing the fireflies with her. 🌙✨ Zero skill required, all vibes welcome — this is the Sunday plan that turns into your new favorite tradition. Brushes in hand, bebida in the other, and a glowing canvas waiting to happen step-by-step. Whether you've never touched a paintbrush or you're low-key an artist, this room levels the playing field fast. Seats fill up quick once word gets out, so don't sleep on this one. 🎨💫

📅 Sunday, September 13 | 6PM–8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $33

Dim lights, midnight-blue canvas, a moon glowing right where Aubrey tells you to put it. 🌕🎨 The room smells like fresh paint and whatever's in your glass, brushes moving slow and steady while fireflies start appearing stroke by stroke. Chatter buzzing low, laughter over a smudged line here and there, and somehow by the end everyone's holding their own little piece of magic. It's the kind of two hours that slows time down — quiet, glowing, unforgettable. ✨🖌️

Come as you are — paint-stained hands optional, good energy required. 🎨💛 Sip and Paint with Aubrey isn't about getting it perfect, it's about showing up and making something yours. Strangers become easy conversation fast when everyone's staring at the same blank canvas trying to figure out fireflies. Never picked up a brush? Doesn't matter. Been painting for years? Also doesn't matter. Everybody leaves with the same glowing forest and a little more connection than they walked in with. This is Azúcar's kind of community — relaxed, creative, all love. 💜
